messages:
zoe: heads-up: noticing intermittent tokenization errors and p95 spike for embeddings in us-west2 since the shard routing change at 02:40 UTC. impacts a small % of customers on long sequences.
michael: can you attach the telemetry & a sample error?
zoe: dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=us-west2 sample error: TokenizerError: invalid-byte-seq at seq 2048.
tara: is this tied to the new shard routing patch or quant kernels?
zoe: correlation looks strongest with shard-routing v1.4.2; quant path touched but less correlated. recommending emergency revert of shard-router to v1.4.1 in us-west2 and reduce batch size to 64 as a precaution.
release_lead: to proceed we need: owner, staged plan, rollback one-liner, changelog text, and SRE approval.
sre_oncall: I can approve a canary if there is a clear rollback and manual gates. Abort if tokenization errors > 0.2% or p95 regresses > 25% for sustained 5m.
michael: I can own the run. plan: slices 1% -> 10% -> 100% with manual approvals.
release_lead: draft release note:
```
Hotfix (expedited): revert shard-router in us-west2 from v1.4.2 -> v1.4.1 and limit embedding batch size to 64 to mitigate tokenization errors and tail latency spikes. No model weight changes.
```
zoe: deploybot, initiate hotpatch: service=embeddings region=us-west2 from=shard-router:v1.4.2 to=shard-router:v1.4.1 owner=michael tag=hotfix-expedited
deploybot: @michael scheduled deploy id=dr-1768881231-q. strategy=staged-canary slices=[1%,10%,100%]; checks=[health, tokenizer-errors, p95, 5xx]; manual approval required between slices.
michael: starting 1% canary now. logs: dr-1768881231-q canary-start.
sre_oncall: monitoring. enable extra tokenization trace logs for the canary slice.
michael: 5m update: tokenizer-errors down from 0.12% -> 0.01% in canary, p95 improved 20%, 5xx stable. approve move to 10%.
deploybot: progressing to 10% slice.
release_lead: posting status update to internal changeboard and flagging billing as expedited. ops on-call standing by.
michael: 12m at 10% stable. recommend proceed to 100%.
sre_oncall: verified metrics stable for 10m. ok to proceed to 100%.
deploybot: rolling out to 100% -> dr-1768881231-q complete status=success.
release_lead: changelog posted and tagged expedited-hotfix. will notify CS with a short summary.
zoe: rollback one-liner for quick revert if needed:
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeddings shard-router=shard-router:v1.4.2 && kubectl rollout status -n prod deploy/embeddings
```
tara: follow-ups: add unit test for tokenizer edge bytes, add canary-weighted sampling for shard-router changes, and schedule RCA with model infra + routing teams.
michael: closing handoff, will open RCA ticket and link here once created. :thumbsup:
